'''Ulrich "Uli" Sutor''' (born 9 May 1960) is a former [[Germany|German]] [[Curling|curler]] and curling [[coach (sport)|coach]].

He is a former European men's curling champion ({{EuCC|1991}}), German men's curling champion (1989) and two-time German mixed curling champion (1989, 1990, silver in 1988, bronze in 1987).<ref name="ger">[http://www.sport-komplett.de/sport-komplett/sportarten/c/curling/hst/6.html Curling - Deutsche Meisterschaften]{{in lang|de}}</ref>
